title: 第二十一章 遇妖第二十二章 开坛做法
content_zh:
“无争，殿主一真的亲传大弟子，今年三十三了吧，二十八岁已经受箓。
“此人长相粗豪，但我听说这人性子还算宽厚，就是做事做人有些直，在下院人缘不太好。”
一平道人对下院小辈情况并不关心，但他毕竟在这里待了多年。
无争作为无字辈的七品受箓道士，在下院风头很盛。
他对于无争的情况，也多少知道一些。
“对了，听说无争最擅长是炼丹和医术。”
一平道人说道：“无争出身云阳府大族，前途广大，不会甘心待在藏龙观。你老实跟着干两年，等你晋级七品，想主持藏龙观还不容易。”
“师叔说的是。”周无纪连连点头。
他最关心其实是无争出身，只要这位不姓张，和张心虎扯不上关系，那就没问题了。
一平道人知道周无纪聪明机敏，但他还是忍不住交代几句：“你回藏龙观，不要去招惹张心虎，七品武者，真要豁出去你可挡不住。
“以你天资，没必要和一个县城的家族斗气。等你晋级五品，一句话就能灭了张家。”
周无纪连连点头，师叔这话也不是夸张。
道门受朝廷供养，自身又有着庞大组织。他真要到了五品，想要拿捏张心虎自然不难。
但是，那不知是多久以后的事情。再说了，他不去找张心虎，张心虎能放过他？
他向来不惮以最坏的恶意揣测别人。与其千日防贼，不如自己先做贼……
只是这些计算却没必要和一平师叔说。
周无纪要走了，终于在堂主那里拿到了十颗金阳丹。
这种七品丹药价格高昂，至愿主持当时一高兴说要奖励十颗，后面就没动静了。
一平道人偷偷和周无纪说：“肯定是主持舍不得后悔了，学习法术已经白占便宜，丹药就别要了。”
周无纪却不想放弃，这东西他还没尝过滋味呢。

马上要走了，他就厚着脸皮去找至愿主持，至愿不管心里怎么想，表面上却是和颜悦色，当即让道童带着他去药堂取了药。
周无纪回到飞玄殿，直接从药盒里取出五颗金阳丹交给一平道人。
一平道人有点意外，他转即推辞道：“我不需要，你年纪小，正是修行精进的时候，你自己留着用。”
他转又叮嘱：“此丹药性有些烈，十天服一颗。”
周无纪直接把五颗金阳丹塞给一平道人：“咱们爷俩对半分，谁也不亏，您这么推辞，那是逼我把丹药全送您才行！”
一平道人失笑，这句玩笑说得真妙，既拉近两人距离，又让他能心安理得收了礼物。
他心里感叹：这个师侄真是聪明极了！在修行上又有天赋，以后必定是前途无量！
周无纪看到一平师叔收了丹药，他也挺高兴。
他能顺利晋级八品，都是师叔关照，送点丹药主要是表达一点心意。
临走的时候，周无纪又去万灵堂祭拜了师父，恳求师父在天之灵保佑他万事顺利！
他也不知道老头有没有这本事，但说说自己诉求总没错，师父在天有灵肯定会尽力帮忙……
content_en:
"Wu Zheng, the eldest disciple of Hall Master Yizhen, he is thirty-three this year, and he has already been sentenced to death at the age of twenty-eight.
"This man has a rough appearance, but I heard that he is quite kind-hearted, but he is a bit straightforward in his conduct and is not very popular in the House of Commons. "
Taoist Yiping doesn't care about the situation of the juniors in the House of Commons, but after all, he has been here for many years.
Wu Zheng, as a seventh-grade Taoist priest of the Wuzi generation, was very popular in the lower court.
He also knew something about Wu Zheng's situation.
"By the way, I heard that Wu Zheng is best at alchemy and medical skills. "
Taoist Yiping said: "Wuzheng comes from a wealthy family in Yunyang Mansion and has a bright future. He will not be willing to stay in Hidden Dragon Temple. If you follow me faithfully for two years, it will not be easy for you to preside over the Hidden Dragon Temple when you advance to the seventh level. "
"That's what Uncle Master said. "Zhou Wuji nodded repeatedly.
What he cares most about is Wu Zheng's origin. As long as this person's surname is not Zhang and has nothing to do with Zhang Xinhu, then there will be no problem.
Taoist Yiping knew that Zhou Wuji was smart and astute, but he couldn't help but say a few words: "When you go back to Hidden Dragon Temple, don't provoke Zhang Xinhu, a seventh-level warrior. If you really want to go all out, you can't stop him.
"With your talent, there is no need to fight against a family in a county. When you advance to the fifth rank, you can destroy the Zhang family with just one sentence."
Zhou Wuji nodded repeatedly. His uncle's words were not an exaggeration.
The Taoist sect is supported by the imperial court and has a large organization of its own. If he really reaches the fifth level, it will not be difficult to control Zhang Xinhu.
But, I don’t know how long it will take. Besides, if he doesn’t go to Zhang Xinhu, can Zhang Xinhu let him go?
He has never been afraid to assume the worst possible ill will in others. Instead of guarding against thieves for a thousand days, it is better to be a thief yourself first...
But there is no need to tell Master Yiping about these calculations.
Zhou Wuji was about to leave, and finally got ten Jinyang Pills from the hall master.
The price of this kind of seventh-grade elixir was very high. The host Zhiyuan was very happy and said that he would reward ten pills, but there was no movement after that.
Taoist Yiping secretly said to Zhou Wuji: "The host must be reluctant to regret it. Learning spells has already been a waste, so don't ask for the pills."
Zhou Wuji didn't want to give up, he hadn't tasted this thing yet.
He was about to leave, so he shamelessly went to see the host Zhiyuan. No matter what he thought in his heart, Zhiyuan was friendly on the surface and immediately asked the Taoist boy to take him to the medicine hall to get medicine.
Zhou Wuji returned to Feixuan Hall and took out five Jinyang Pills directly from the medicine box and handed them to Taoist Yiping.
Taoist Yiping was a little surprised. He immediately declined and said, "I don't need it. You are young and it is time for you to practice diligently. You can keep it for yourself."
He then warned: "This elixir is somewhat strong in nature. Take one pill every ten days."
Zhou Wuji directly handed the five Golden Yang Pills to Taoist Yi Ping: "We split it half and half, no one loses. If you refuse like this, you are forcing me to give you all the pills!"
Taoist Yiping laughed. This joke was so clever. It not only brought the two of them closer, but also allowed him to accept the gift with peace of mind.
He sighed in his heart: This nephew is really smart! If you are talented in spiritual practice, you will definitely have a bright future!
Zhou Wuji was also very happy when he saw Master Yiping collecting the elixir.
He was able to successfully advance to the eighth level because of his uncle's care. The main reason for giving him some pills was to express his feelings.
Before leaving, Zhou Wuji went to the Wanling Hall to worship his master and begged his master's spirit in heaven to bless him with everything going well!
He didn't know if the old man had this ability, but he was right to make his request. The master in heaven would definitely try his best to help...
